title: What Molecular Logic Gates Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Molecular logic gates perform Boolean operations with molecules instead of transistors: chemical inputs (specific DNA strands, ions, light) produce chemical outputs through designed reactions. They are the transistors of a future molecular computer. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Molecular Logic Gates: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Molecular Logic Gates in one line: Molecular logic gates perform Boolean operations with molecules instead of transistors: chemical inputs (specific DNA strands, ions, light) produce chemical outputs through designed reactions.
Why it matters: They enable computation inside chemical and biological environments where electronics cannot go..
Where it is used: smart diagnostics, molecular computing, chemical process control, in-vivo logic..
